cd /workspace/scratch && timeout 150 python3 -c "
import sys, random, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, analyze
rng = random.Random(1)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False)
inst = analyze._parse_request(req)
t0=time.time()
res = analyze.analyze(inst, req['id'])
t1=time.time()
print('time %.2f' % (t1-t0), res.get('status'), res.get('min_faults'))
print(json.dumps(res.get('faults')))
" 2>&1 | tail -3
